item.title: Lunch
item.description:
Lunch Menu

Starters

Homemade Soup(s) - Starter: £6 / Large: £8

Served with rustic bread and butter.

Baked Camembert & Artisan Sharer - £9.50

Infused with rosemary, garlic and honey.

Chinese Duck Bon Bons - £8

Shredded duck in a sweet hoisin sause coated in bread crumbs.

Chicken Wings and Slaw - £7

Battered Calamari - £6

Calamari rings served with garlic mayo.

Burgers

All burgers are served with chip and slaw unless stated otherwise.
